text:
kevin: Noticed a weird chart on console: p50 jumped above p95 for /v1/embeddings around 1767300100. anyone else?
alyssa: Wait what, p50 > p95? screenshots? :eyes:
noah: I can reproduce in the dashboard — p50=210ms, p95=190ms for a short window.
tess: That usually means mixed sample origins or aggregation bug. Did we change the routing split?
console-bot: rollout: route-split a/b-variant applied region eu-central at 1767300055 by @noah.
kevin: We flipped a routing policy that sends 20% to model-b (higher latency) and 80% to model-a. The times above don't match that.
alyssa: Could sampling be non-uniform? If p95 window has fewer heavy hitters due to sampling, p50 could look higher.
noah: I pulled raw tail samples. Quick query: 
```
SELECT sample_origin, count(*) as cnt, percentile(lat_ms,50) as p50, percentile(lat_ms,95) as p95
FROM latency_events
WHERE route='/v1/embeddings' AND ts BETWEEN 1767300000 AND 1767300300
GROUP BY sample_origin
```
kevin: What did it show?
noah: Results: client: cnt=8k p50=180 p95=320; aggregator: cnt=400 p50=220 p95=190; merged-rollup: cnt=8400 p50=210 p95=190.
tess: There it is: aggregator p95 < p50 because aggregator sample size small and skewed. merged-rollup uses aggregator-first merge order and overwrote percentiles.
alyssa: So merge semantics are asymmetric. Are we using t-digest rollups or histogram buckets?
noah: t-digest for per-host then merge via weighted tdigest. But some places do percentile-by-quantile naive merge (bug).
kevin: Does console show merge-mode anywhere? No label currently. That's bad. Users assume pctl is uniform.
console-bot: telemetry-note: recent change merged sample_origin into unified events for easier querying (PR #3421).
tess: That PR unintentionally changed the order of merges; small-origin groups now dominate certain quantiles.
alyssa: Immediate mitigation: filter dashboard to sample_origin=client for SLO widgets. Long-term: add provenance legend + expose merge_mode (tdigest | histogram | naive) and sample_counts in tooltip.
noah: Suggestion: when merging, if sample_count < threshold (e.g., 1000) mark origin as low-confidence and don't include in rollups for pctl SLOs by default. Low-confidence could still appear in raw drilldowns.
kevin: Also add a dashboard alert when p50 > p95 or quantile inversion occurs, with link to breakdown by origin. That will give early visibility.
tess: Agreed. I'll open two tickets: one to revert the merge-order change in PR #3421 and one to implement the low-confidence filter + UI.
alyssa: I'll prototype an alert rule and a small UI mock for the provenance legend.
noah: I'll run a patch to re-calc merged tdigest using client-first ordering and publish new rollups for eu-central.
quota-bot: quota: note that quota-enforcement telemetry still collects post-route metrics for billing and should remain separate from console rollups.
kevin: Good call. Explicitly separate quota telemetry stream so we don't relabel main latency events.
tess: Action items recap: noah recalculates rollups, tess tickets (revert PR + low-conf filter), alyssa alert + mock, kevin doc the separation policy. Check back in 30m to see if inversion clears. :clock1:
